messages:
Priya K: paging — got the alert for elevated 5xx on /v1/generate (us-west-2). APM shows spike ~09:10 UTC. Opening a quick war room: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij (join if you're oncall). Creating an internal incident thread here.
inc-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-04-23-001 — Priority: P1. Pager acknowledged by Priya K.
deploy-bot: Recent deploy detected: frontend/commit@a1b2c3 (09:07 UTC) — pipeline: ci/prod. No automatic rollback triggered.
Marco S: I'll take incident lead (oncall rotation says I'm next). Kicking off immediate checks: logs, router, autoscale.
Tilly (SRE): I'll look into proxy metrics and infra autoscaler. pinging infra-owner and checking connection limits.
Alice L: product — do we know customer impact surface? Any dedicated customers or just hosted API tenants?
Priya K: quick snapshot — 5xx rate ~7% across the fleet, concentrated in us-west-2 AZs. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate mostly; embeddings endpoints not showing same spike. No evidence of data loss.
Priya K: logs (truncated):
```
[09:10:12] proxy-01 ERROR upstream 502 "alloc failed: kv-cache OOM"
[09:10:13] proxy-02 WARN delay_queue length=312
[09:11:02] worker-03 ERROR model-runner timeout 120s
```
Marco S: runbook says start with: 1) check autoscale groups & node health 2) check recent deploys 3) scale proxies if backlog present. I'm executing the checks now.
Tilly (SRE): autoscale groups show instances healthy, but proxy request_queue is saturated on proxy replicas (avg queue 250). I'll scale proxy pool to reduce queuing. Running: `kubectl scale deployment proxy --replicas=6 -n prod`
deploy-bot: Scale event: proxy replicas scaled from 3 -> 6 by Tilly (09:14 UTC).
Marco S: after scale, tailing logs and error rate — initial signs are positive, error rate dropping to ~2.1%. Retrying client requests should succeed.
Priya K: draft status page update for sign-off: 
"We are investigating increased error rates impacting text-generation endpoints in US-West. Mitigation is underway (scaling proxies). No data loss expected. We will provide another update within 30 minutes."
Alice L: suggested edit: add "If you are experiencing errors, please retry requests; queued requests may be served shortly. Customers on Dedicated pools: we don't currently see errors in Dedicated instances, please contact support if you see otherwise." Also attach short CS template.
Priya K: CS notification template (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating intermittent 5xx errors affecting text-generation in US-West. We’re actively mitigating; no data loss expected. We’ll follow up with a remediation timeline. If you’re seeing persistent failures, please reply and include request IDs. — Redwood Support"
Marco S: update: error rate now ~1.2% (09:20 UTC) and latency back to baseline for most traffic. Marking state as: Mitigating. Continuing to monitor.
Tilly (SRE): monitoring dashboards show dropped error counts, but queue len still above baseline in one AZ. I'll leave scaled replicas for 20 more minutes and then gradually scale down if stable.
Priya K: handoff plan: I'll stay on this thread and monitor for the next 45 minutes; planning to hand off to Tilly at 10:30 UTC if stable. Tilly, please confirm you'll take post-incident monitoring and own the follow-up RCA if this doesn't fully resolve.
Tilly (SRE): ack — I'll take handoff at 10:30 UTC and own the follow-up investigation into proxy queueing and connection limits.
Marco S: I'll own the root-cause ticket and start collecting traces + request IDs for sample failures. Creating ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234 (assigned to Marco S).
Priya K: action items summary: 1) Tilly — validate long-term scaling policy and queue thresholds (owner: Tilly). 2) Marco — RCA and traces (owner: Marco). 3) Alice/product — review customer comms and post to status page once we move to monitoring. 4) CS — use template to notify any customers who open tickets.
inc-bot: Update recorded: state changed to MITIGATING; next automated reminder in 30m.
Priya K: Thanks all — if numbers regress, please @channel and we'll re-open the war room. Otherwise I'll post a final update and close the room after handoff window. :thumbsup:
